aboutPage.title: About Us
aboutPage.subtitle: Because a healthy pet is a happy pet!
aboutPage.introText: Today, good pet food needs to do much more than just satisfy hunger. For more than 50 years, our love of pets has been the greatest motivator in our search for the perfect recipe for our natural and healthy Premium Pet Food. We are committed to the following values
aboutPage.forLoveOfPetsText: We want to enable every pet to have a long, healthy and happy life. The special requirements of our four-legged customers are very important to us. For more than 50 years, we have been passionately developing perfect recipes that are ideally adapted to the living conditions of our four-legged friends. We produce our premium Happy Cat Happy Dog Brand with a lot of love and passion and adapt it to every phase of life and every need.
aboutPage.forLoveOfNatureText: We use only natural ingredients for our high-quality dog & cat food. Up to 80% comes from the region around Augsburg. As a matter of principle, we do not use any artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. In addition, we make sure that our GMO-free dog & cat food does not harm the environment or come at the expense of animal welfare. An awareness of nature influences our daily actions and sustainably shapes Happy Cat Happy Dog products - to be in harmony with mankind and nature.
aboutPage.forLoveOfQualityText: We use only natural ingredients for our high-quality dog & cat food. Up to 80% comes from the region around Augsburg. As a matter of principle, we do not use any artificial colours, flavours or preservatives. In addition, we make sure that our GMO-free dog & cat food does not harm the environment or come at the expense of animal welfare. An awareness of nature influences our daily actions and sustainably shapes Happy Cat Happy Dog products - to be in harmony with mankind and nature.
aboutPage.forLoveOfTraditionText: Our family business has been producing food of the highest quality since 1765. Our first-class dog & cat food made from high-quality and natural ingredients has been produced in Wehringen, Bavaria, for over 50 years. The Happy Cat Happy Dog brand offers a species-appropriate and healthy diet for your pet and is designed for good palatability, easy digestibility and tolerance.
aboutPage.nutritionalConceptText: We use nature as our guide for the production of our premium dog food
aboutPage.manufacturingProcessText: Our pet food is produced using the perfect recipe in the Thermos tufenmix®
aboutPage.brandHistoryText: Our pet food is produced using the perfect recipe in the Thermostufenmix®
aboutPage.socialCommitmentText: For us, social responsibility also means thinking of others and acting responsibly
aboutPage.manufacturingTitle: Would you like to know how Happy Dog dry food is made?
aboutPage.manufacturingIntro: Do you feed your pet Happy Dog dry food every day and are you interested in how our high-quality dog ​​food is prepared? Here we explain step by step how our croquettes are made: from the natural ingredients to the delicious dry food.
aboutPage.manufacturingProcess2: Take the right portion of meat and nutrient-rich offal and combine them with valuable plant-based nutrients and healthy carbohydrate sources, such as potatoes. We achieve a particularly gentle preparation with the Thermostufenmix®. This is how tasty Happy Dog dry food of the highest quality is produced in Wehringen, Bavaria.
aboutPage.farmYardSubtitle: Natural raw materials from farmers from our Bavarian homeland
aboutPage.farmYardText: We place the rearing of animals and the cultivation of plant-based raw materials in the hands of our carefully selected agricultural partners. Animal welfare-friendly rearing is extremely important to us when it comes to our meat suppliers. We also attach great importance to sourcing as many of the plant-based raw materials as possible, such as grain, potatoes and local herbs, from predominantly regional agriculture.
aboutPage.deliverySubtitle: Short delivery routes for more freshness
aboutPage.deliveryText: The majority of our ingredients come from the region around Augsburg. Because of the short travel distances, we always receive fresh produce straight from the fields. This way we protect the environment and support the farmers in our homeland.
aboutPage.millMixerText: All raw materials for our premium dog food are checked for foreign bodies using several vibrating screens and magnets so that your pet only gets perfect food. The ingredients are then ground and mixed in a mill. This process takes around 4 minutes.
aboutPage.thermostufenmixSubtitle: Gentle preparation: this preserves vitamins and nutrients
aboutPage.thermostufenmixText: The feed mixture is first gently pre-treated with steam and heated for about an hour. In the second stage, the mixture is kneaded in the extruder tube at a minimum of 90 degrees Celsius and then shaped into croquettes.
aboutPage.dryingRefiningText: The croquettes are dried for 22 minutes at 125 degrees Celsius. After that, they only have a maximum moisture content of 12%, which ensures a longer shelf life. Finally, the dry food is refined with high-quality oils and antioxidants and cooled to ambient temperature.
aboutPage.checkPackSubtitle: Quality control: Because only the best ends up in the bag
aboutPage.checkPackText: The croquettes are put through a metal detector again, because the highest quality is our top priority. That is why the finished croquettes are also carefully checked in the laboratory. Only when we are completely sure that our premium dog food has been produced in the best quality using natural ingredients and the perfect recipe, are the croquettes packed in bags of different sizes. This is quality made in Germany.
aboutPage.brandHistorySubtitle: The history of our dog food brand since 1970
aboutPage.brandHistoryIntro: How the pioneer of complete dog flake food became the leading specialist retail brand in the field of dry dog ​​food and ultimately the best dog food brand in Germany... It all began in 1965 when dog food consisting of wet food and flakes was first produced in Wehringen, Bavaria, and sold under the name Müller's dog food. In 1970, Edmund Müller developed one of the first highly digestible complete foods for dogs. At that time, the food consisted of dried meat, corn flakes and vegetables and was particularly popular with dog breeders. That was the starting signal for the Happy Dog brand. Since then, the Müllers have made it their mission in their family business to perfect their dog food. With success, because Happy Dog was named the best dog food brand in Germany in 2019. Today we present ourselves as the home of healthy pet food and guarantee premium dog food of the highest quality - made in Germany.
aboutPage.developmentTitle: Development of the Happy Dog brand
aboutPage.packagingTitle: The development of Happy Dog packaging
aboutPage.packagingText: In 1970, when the Müller family first produced dog food under the name Happy Dog, the bags were very simple. Over the years, the packaging has been continuously developed to protect the high quality of the product as best as possible and to ensure freshness. In addition, the information for dog owners on the multifunctional packaging with regard to the ingredients and feeding recommendations has become increasingly important.
aboutPage.nutritionalTitle: Of course only the best for your four-legged friend with the Happy Dog Natural Life Concept
aboutPage.naturalIngredientsText1: of the highest quality are the basis of our species-appropriate and balanced recipes
aboutPage.naturalIngredientsText2: optimally meet the needs and requirements of your dog
aboutPage.naturalIngredientsText3: without the addition of artificial preservatives and independently controlled
aboutPage.philosophyText: With this philosophy, we have been producing our Happy Dog products in Wehringen, Bavaria, for over 50 years. But what exactly is in our products?
aboutPage.meatDescription: Meat and valuable animal proteins of the highest quality are the most important components of our pet food because of their essential amino acids. In Happy Dog dry food, the proportion of animal protein in the total protein is up to 90%
aboutPage.natureModel: We take nature as our model
aboutPage.natureModelText: The Happy Dog Natural Life Concept® offers your dog a nutritionally sensible combination of all vital nutrients with natural ingredients. This provides optimal and species-appropriate support for the metabolism and the entire organism - nutritionally proven based on the model of nature.
aboutPage.additionalText: In addition to the main ingredient, meat, and depending on the variety, different carbohydrate sources from regional cultivation, Happy Dog dry food contains natural components such as herbs, linseed or seaweed. In order to support the metabolism optimally and in a species-appropriate manner, natural products with health-promoting properties are irreplaceable. This way, your dog is provided with everything that the organism benefits from in its entirety - from a strong immune system to a healthy coat! Of course, we select the healthy natural ingredients for our premium dog food specifically based on whether they have a positive effect on the health of your furry friend and combine them to create an optimal nutrient mix. This way, you can be sure that your dog is neither over- nor under-supplied and that no deficiency symptoms arise.
aboutPage.nutritionPropertiesTitle: The Happy Dog nutrition concept & its health-promoting properties:
aboutPage.selectedHerbsText: Natural helpers for the organism - good for the stomach, intestines, circulation and respiratory tract
aboutPage.appleText: pectin-containing fiber ensures regulated digestion and a stable intestinal flora
aboutPage.gingerText: to strengthen the immune system and the musculoskeletal system
aboutPage.seaweedText: Natural supplier of a wide range of vital nutrients, e.g. minerals and amino acids - for more well-being and a shiny coat
aboutPage.greenLippedMusselText: rich in glycosaminoglycans to support the joints and synovial fluid and therefore good for the musculoskeletal system
aboutPage.linseedOilText: rich in essential omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids for regulated digestion and a shiny coat
aboutPage.yeastExtractedText: Mannanoligosaccharides (MOS) and nucleotides from yeast cell walls are good for a strong immune system (nucleotides help in the regeneration of DNA)
aboutPage.yeastDriedText: to support a stable intestinal flora
aboutPage.wellCaredText: Vitamins, minerals and trace elements as well as fat, protein, crude fiber and carbohydrates are vital for our pets. Our balanced and varied pet food ensures an adequate supply of these substances and is supplemented by a variety of healthy ingredients from nature. We take nature as our model and refine our dog food recipes with healthy herbs from the region. For every Happy Dog food you will find precise information on the composition on the packaging or on our website, which tells you which ingredients are contained in the respective food. Depending on which health aspect you want to support, you can choose your food accordingly.
aboutPage.exampleTitle: Example from our whole food diet for illustration
aboutPage.exampleSubtitle: The Happy Dog dry food Medium Adult from the fit & vital line has the following composition:
aboutPage.compositionText: Animal proteins* (14% poultry, 4% lamb), corn, corn flour, rice, barley, oils and fats, fish meal (5%, of which 50% salmon meal), hemoglobin*, hydrolysed protein, beet molasses pulp* (desugared), apple pomace*, potassium chloride, yeast*, sodium chloride, seaweed*, linseed (0.16%), dried whole egg (0.12%), milk thistle, mussel meat* (0.02%), yeast* (extracted), artichoke, dandelion, ginger (0.016%), birch leaves, nettle, chamomile, coriander, rosemary, sage, liquorice root, thyme (total dried herbs: 0.16%), *) dried.
aboutPage.conclusionText: The linseed contained in it, for example, is rich in omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids and has a high content of lecithin and vitamin E. This can have a positive effect on the skin and fur and has an antioxidant effect. In addition, the meat of the green-lipped mussel is rich in glycosaminoglycans and is therefore good for the joints, and the ginger it contains supports the immune system. With our healthy, whole foods, your four-legged friend is well looked after. Depending on your dog's special needs, you can choose the right food from our range. If you are unsure about choosing the right food, our nutrition experts will be happy to give you advice on food.
aboutPage.conclusionFinal: Today, good dog food has to do much more than just fill you up! That's why Happy Dog's balanced dog food contains natural herbs in addition to the animal proteins and important fiber that dogs need. This way, your darling will stay fit and healthy for a lifetime!
aboutPage.socialK9Text: Tracking down missing people and animals The search dog center, run by Alexandra Grunow and Rovena Lankau, trains dogs that can track people down using their scent. In addition to training the K-9 trail trainers, they have been helping the police and the State Criminal Police Office throughout Germany for years on a voluntary basis in the areas of rescue and forensics in real-life operations to track down missing people or pets. "Our dogs track down lost people before they are lost forever," is how Alexandra Grunow describes her work. Happy Dog supports the search dog center with food and material donations, joint campaigns and events.
aboutPage.socialVetText: The work of Veterinarians Without Borders benefits the health of animals, people and the environment in its six project countries in East Africa. The people there are characterized by a rich history and often extensive knowledge that has been passed down through generations. The association wants to preserve this valuable heritage and expand it through veterinary and human medical knowledge. The knowledge, experiences and life strategies of the people in the projects are the heart of the association's work - it supports them in leading a healthy and self-determined life in harmony with their animals in a healthy environment. Happy Dog has been supporting Veterinarians Without Borders' vaccination campaign in Africa since 2020, thereby positioning itself in the fight against rabies. Become a supporting member now and you too can support Veterinarians Without Borders' efforts to eliminate human cases of rabies.
aboutPage.socialSOSText: Already 2 million euros donated! Since the introduction of Happy Dog Sensible Africa and Mini Africa in May 2009, Happy Dog has donated 2% of the purchase price of every Africa pack sold (from 1 kg) to SOS Children's Villages in Africa. This great campaign has already enabled 2 million euros to be donated (as of October 2022). A big thank you to you as a customer! You too can help: support the initiative by purchasing Happy Dog Sensible Africa or Mini Africa! For every Africa pack sold (from 1 kg), Happy Dog donates up to EUR 1.61 to SOS Children's Villages.
aboutPage.educationAfricaText1: Since the extension of the primary school in Rutana/Burundi was completed with the support of Happy Dog, we are now able to support the next project: "Education for a better future in Africa". Due to poverty and violence, around 124 million children and young people in Africa are denied school education.
aboutPage.educationAfricaText2: Together with SOS Children's Villages, we want to counteract this. In cooperation with educational authorities, schools and community organizations, the children should be given free access to a high-quality education. Because only with a good school education can they have a path to working life. By purchasing Happy Dog Sensible Africa and Mini Africa, you are helping to finance numerous items:
aboutPage.educationItem1: Ongoing costs for school and vocational training
aboutPage.educationItem3: Payment of educational staff and much more
aboutPage.socialFeedDogText: Food donations for dogs in need We have been supporting feed a dog's charitable work since 2022 and are proud that we have already been able to fill over 260,964 bowls together. Animal welfare is very important to us as a pet food manufacturer, which is why we are fully behind the feed a dog concept:Doing good has never been so easy. With the help of the feed a dog app, donating only takes one click. Just 1.50 euros is enough to fill a dog bowl. What you have to do:Install the free feed a dog app on your phone and you can donate. You decide who you want to support.Happy Dog will then double your donation, no matter how much it is! More information about feed a dog
aboutPage.moreInfoFeedDog: More Information about Feed a Dog
aboutPage.socialDogsStorksText: Newborn and Infant Safety Program Happy Dog supports the "Dogs & Storks" program and the follow-up program "Dogs & Babies" with the aim of increasing the safety of newborns and small children in households with dogs and reducing the number of dogs that are given away due to an increase in the family. With the support of Happy Dog, lectures for pregnant women with dogs can be offered free of charge.
aboutPage.programObjectives: The objectives of the program are:
aboutPage.objective1: To increase the safety of newborns in households with dogs.
aboutPage.objective2: To reduce concerns and uncertainty among expectant or new parents through education.
aboutPage.objective3: To reduce the number of dogs that are given up due to family growth.
aboutPage.objective4: To support families in leading a harmonious everyday life with baby and dog.
aboutPage.programUnique: What makes "Dogs & Storks" and its follow-up program "Dogs & Babies" unique? All content is based on scientific analysis, behavioral science and modern animal training and is running successfully with over 200 speakers in America, Australia, Asia and Europe. In Germany, Austria and Switzerland, the two programs are coordinated by Mag. Bina Lunzer, cert.CBST.
aboutPage.socialVDHText: Official Partner of the VDH The Association for German Dogs (VDH for short) is the leading lobby for all dog owners in Germany - the first port of call for everything to do with dogs, dog sports and dog breeding.We at Happy Dog work closely with the VDH and regularly support the association's campaigns and events with our commitment. Every year, at the beginning of June, it is Dog Day nationwide.It is duly celebrated with hundreds of events organized by dog ​​clubs, veterinary facilities and many other organizations.As an official partner of the VDH, Happy Dog supports the organizers of their campaigns every year with a generous number of food samples that can be distributed to all participants.
aboutPage.socialZooText: For species-appropriate animal husbandry Many measures are necessary to ensure that zoo animals are kept in the most species-appropriate way possible: optimally designed enclosures, individual activities for each animal species and species-appropriate feeding of the animals are just a few examples that modern zoos take into account today.In order to be able to finance such measures, the zoo needs financial resources from sponsors such as Happy Dog.In addition, our sponsorship contribution enables kindergarten groups and school classes in particular to learn about the animal world not only in theory, but also in practice.
aboutPage.year1765Text: With the purchase of the old mill in Wehringen, the Müller family laid the historical foundation stone for the Interquell company today. At that time, Nikolaus Müller started operating his flour mill on the Singold.
aboutPage.year1951Text: Edmund Müller produced the first potato flakes. Due to their easy digestibility and good shelf-life, they offered a significant improvement for farmers in pig feeding.
aboutPage.year1965Text: First dog food production started with 'Müller's dog food'. This consisted of flakes and wet food.
aboutPage.year1970Text: Edmund Müller developed one of the first easily digestible complete food for dogs, consisting of dried meat, maize flakes and vegetables. Müller's dog food brand became Happy Dog.
aboutPage.year1973Text: Happy Dog exported abroad for the first time: to Austria and Denmark.
aboutPage.year1975Text: The first extruder for the production of dog and cat food in croquette form started up and complemented the previous production of food flakes.
aboutPage.year1987Text: Georg Müller (Dipl. oec.) joined the family business in its 7th generation. After the death of the company founder in 1988, he took over the business.
aboutPage.year1992Text: With Happy Dog NaturCroq, Interquell launched the first complete food for dogs in croquette form onto the market.
aboutPage.year2000Text: Happy Dog entered the super premium segment for dog food with Supreme Salmon and Rabbit. The first 'sensitive' varieties were Ireland, Toscana and New Zealand.
aboutPage.year2001Text: Interquell developed dry food for cats for the first time: Happy Cat was born.
aboutPage.year20042006Text: A new office building, two more extruder lines and a silo tower were built. This created a production capacity of 200 tonnes per day.
aboutPage.year2009Text: Happy Dog Supreme Africa is the first dog food in the world to contain ostrich as a protein source. For every pack sold since then 2% of the purchase price is donated to SOS Children's Villages in Africa. To date, a total of 1.8 million euros!
aboutPage.year2015Text: Happy Dog became the leading specialist retail brand in Germany in the dry dog food sector.
aboutPage.year2018ClimateText: Good is Interquell's first premium dog food that is completely climate-neutral - from the field to the bowl.
aboutPage.year2018GenerationText: Annika and Andreas Müller join the family business in its 8th generation
aboutPage.year2019AwardText: Happy Cat Junior was named 2019 Product of the Year by FutterTester.de.
aboutPage.year2019ExportText: This popular premium pet food is now shipped to 75 countries and is available on 4 continents.
aboutPage.year2020CapacityText: With the commissioning of an additional extruder, fresh raw materials can now also be processed. Production capacity increases to 320 tonnes of pet food per day.
aboutPage.year2020ProductText: No less than three products received the award for 2020 Product of the Year from FutterTester.de: Happy Cat Bio in the category Wet Cat Food Happy Dog Soft Snack for Dog Snacks and Goood Freilandlamm for dry dog food
aboutPage.year2021RelaunchText: Happy Cat products now have improved recipes and have been given a new look.
aboutPage.year2021ProductText: The best food from all tests in 2021 and crowned as the Product of the Year 2021 by Futtertester.de: Happy Cat Culinary in the dry cat food category Happy Dog fit & vital Medium Adult in the dry dog food category
aboutPage.year2021SealText: Our new vegetarian variety Sensible India excelled in the food test, being awarded 9.3 out of 10 stars.
aboutPage.year2022AwardText: The pet novelty of the year 2021/2022 in the dog category was Sensible India
aboutPage.year2022ProductText: The newly launched Happy Cat Culinary Crunchy Snacks are awarded Product of the Year 2022 by FutterTester
aboutPage.year2022PuppyText: The new Happy Dog Young varieties were rated very good- by FutterTester
aboutPage.year2022RatedText: Independent testers rate 41 dry food brands: 1st place for Happy Cat
aboutPage.year2023MiniText: All products for small dog breeds have a new look and are now even tastier.
aboutPage.year2023ProductsText: In the categories "Wet dog food", "Snack for dogs" and "Dry cat food", we received the Product of the Year 2023 award from the independent portal FutterTester.de.
aboutPage.year2023SolarText: In order to be able to generate part of our electricity requirements ourselves from renewable sources, we built a solar field next to the company premises in 2023.
aboutPage.year2023BestRatedText: For the 3rd time in a row, Happy Cat dry food takes first place with 4.7 out of 5 stars.
aboutPage.year2023TopBrandText: The popular pet magazine hundkatzemaus has awarded us the Top Pet Brand 2023 for our cat snacks.
aboutPage.year2024Text: Our premium dog and cat food is now exported to 84 countries.

faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about Happy Pet

questions.question: How do I know if my pet is truly happy?
questions.answer: A happy pet is one that's healthy, active, and emotionally balanced. Look for wagging tails, bright eyes, good appetite, and affectionate behavior — and use our AI Happiness Tracker to monitor your pet's wellbeing.

questions.question: Is Happy Pet available as a mobile app?
questions.answer: Yes, Happy Pet is available on both iOS and Android platforms. You can download it from the App Store or Google Play Store for convenient access on the go.

questions.question: What can I learn in the Pet Learning Module?
questions.answer: The Pet Learning Module offers comprehensive courses on pet care, nutrition, behavior training, health management, and more. All content is created by pet experts.

questions.question: What is the Pet AI Agent?
questions.answer: Our Pet AI Agent is an intelligent assistant that provides personalized recommendations for your pet's care, answers health questions, and helps you make informed decisions about your pet's wellbeing.

questions.question: Can I get customized advice for my pet's breed or age?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Our AI system analyzes your pet's specific breed, age, and health profile to provide tailored advice and recommendations.

sections.title: Definitions of Key Terms
